rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored or approved by ADA and affiliates, ADHA and affiliates, Academy of General Dentistry, American Academy of Dental Hygiene, National Dental Association, American Association of Dental Boards, CODA-accredited dental schools, armed services/VA dental departments, recognized specialty societies, ACCME; AHA/Red Cross for CPR; JCAHO hospital courses for staff
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first renewal, except the one-time 3-hour opioid course and CPR/BLS (first renewal: upload the opioid certificate from initial licensure).
rules.carryover: Late hours (completed by August of the next year) do not count toward the next period.
rules.audit_note: CE reported in CE Broker by December 31; licensees shown complete are exempt from audit for that period. Keep records 3 calendar years.

topics.who: Opioid management (drug diversion, prescribing controlled substances, addiction treatment); exempt with a notarized affidavit of no CDS prescribing in the period
Current BLS (AHA/Red Cross, not fully online), also at first renewal; earns 3 h

rules.notes: 20 h personally attended clinical + 10 h clinical in person, online or correspondence (with a test). Real-time interactive webinars count as attended. BLS (AHA/Red Cross, not fully online) must be kept current; earns 3 h. Sedation/GA permit: 6-12 h in-person sedation course per period; ACLS/PALS.
rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. XXXIII, §1611
rules.rule_quote: Unless exempted under §1607, each dentist shall complete a minimum of 30 hours of continuing education…
